Card

A bounded surface for one thing — a record, a summary, a choice — with an optional heading row and action row, padded and spaced by the theme's rhythm.

Basic usage

Install the package:

pnpm add @design-schema/react

Import the stylesheet once for the app, then the component:

import '@design-schema/react/index.css';
import { Card } from '@design-schema/react';

Examples

Team plan

Unlimited projects, priority support and advanced analytics for growing teams.

$24/month, billed annually. 

import { Card, Stack, Text, Button } from '@design-schema/react';

const body = (
  <Stack gap="tight">
    <Text element="p">Unlimited projects, priority support and advanced analytics for growing teams.</Text>
    <Text element="p" tone="muted" size="sm">
      $24/month, billed annually.
    </Text>
  </Stack>
);

const footer = <Button label="Choose plan" variant="primary" size="sm" />;

<Card heading="Team plan" footer={footer}>{body}</Card>

children requiredcontent—

The body. Usually a Stack of Text and controls.

The card's title, rendered as a Heading at the card's level. Omit for cards that are a single piece of content.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
headingLevel2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 63

Heading level for `heading`, so cards fit the page outline. Cards in a list share a level.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
headerActionscontent—

Controls at the end of the header row — a ghost icon-only Button, a Link. At most two.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
footercontent—

The action row. Buttons in a row, primary first, following Form's action-order rule.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
insetsm | md | lgmd

Padding inside the card from the layout inset presets. `sm` for dense grids, `lg` for a single featured card.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
surfacedefault | subtledefault

`default` is the page background with a border — the calm option; `subtle` is a tinted surface without a border.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
interactivebooleanfalse

The whole card is one link or button target. Requires exactly one interactive child (a Link or Button) whose action the card extends to its full area; the card itself is not focusable.

Accessibility: The card never becomes a second focus stop; its single child link or button is the target, and the card enlarges the hit area only (pseudo-element on web, wrapping Pressable on native).

web, lit, rn, swiftui
focusablebooleanfalse

The card root takes tabindex=-1 so a container (Feed) can move focus to it by script, and draws its own focus ring when focused that way. Not a tab stop; not for making cards clickable (`interactive`).

Accessibility: Only scripted focus (PageUp/PageDown in a Feed) lands here; the ring is drawn on the card via :focus-visible.

web, lit, rn, swiftui

Accessibility

Decisions this component leaves to you

Choose the heading level so it follows the heading above it on your page. The component will not guess the outline it lands in.

No implicit ARIA role — the component is styling and structure, and adds nothing to the accessibility tree.

Anatomy

surfaceheaderheadingheaderActionsbodyfooter

What generation guarantees

Heading hierarchy — Headings this component renders take their level from the caller, so the page outline never skips a level.

Visible focus — Keyboard focus is always drawn, from the theme’s focus tokens, and is never removed.

Contrast — Text and meaningful non-text contrast meets WCAG AA; the pairs are listed below.
